$doc: Neutral answer record for the exact papercusp-iphone-app@0.1.0 closure. Replace every answer; never add secrets, signing values, provisioning profiles, or remote-host credentials.

decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-app:iphone-app-purpose: Harbor Mobile is an offline-first field-log app; this record supplies every base and iPhone-shell decision for the first iPhone release.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:product-domain: Validated field-log entries, synchronization state transitions, serialization, and error taxonomy live in Rust; SwiftUI owns presentation and iPhone lifecycle.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:rust-msrv: Rust 1.88 across the workspace and CI.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:license-and-reposi: Apache-2.0, Harbor Mobile contributors, and the final public repository URL replace all neutral starter metadata.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:design-token-sourc: design/mobile-tokens.json is the single source for product colors, spacing, radii, and typography; generated Kotlin and Swift outputs are drift-checked.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:optional-capabilit: Credentials and deep links are selected; push, analytics, crash reporting, camera, microphone, media playback, and local networking are not selected.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:runtime-configurat: Non-secret service endpoints are runtime inputs; device credentials use platform secure storage and no provider value enters this file.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-identity: Bundle ID dev.harbor.mobile, product and scheme Harbor, core module HarborCore, generated project Harbor.xcodeproj, and versions from HARBOR_IOS_RELEASE_VERSION plus HARBOR_IOS_BUILD_NUMBER.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-os-floor: Keep the iPhone deployment target at 17.0.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-capabiliti: Declare the selected credentials and deep-link seams only; keep entitlement, privacy, background-mode, URL-scheme, associated-domain, and Swift-package inputs empty unless selected.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-test-host: Run XcodeGen, XCFramework, Swift module, XCTest, XCUITest, privacy, and archive preflight on a local macOS host; Linux reports host-constrained rather than green.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-release: Use external HARBOR_IOS_RELEASE_* team, identity, and provisioning input names, bind archive/export provenance to the requested version and clean source, use development export for the starter, and perform no upload.
